title: kampodra.json
description: kampodra repo manifest: project naming only. Committed per-project, discovered upward (nearest file wins), parsed strictly — unknown keys fail closed. Hosts, ssh keys, and secret material never belong here (those live in ~/.kampodra profiles, 0600).

$schema.description: Point at this schema file for editor autocomplete/validation. Accepted and ignored by kampodra itself.

container.description: The app container/service name (deploy target, restart, logs, kamal-proxy target).

images.description: Secondary (sidecar) images deploy builds+streams+tags alongside the primary app image — no manual podman build/save/load.

sidecars.description: Declared sidecar images. Each builds from its repo-relative dockerfile, streams over the deploy's ssh, and lands on the VM as <imagePrefix>-<name>:latest.

name.description: Sidecar name — the image ref derives as <imagePrefix>-<name> (lowercase alnum, dash, underscore).

dockerfile.description: Repo-relative Dockerfile/Containerfile to build the sidecar from.

shadowSuffix.description: Suffix for the rolling deploy's shadow container.

envFile.description: Remote env file path on the VM (0600).

dataDir.description: Tenant/app data dir on the VM.

healthPath.description: App health endpoint behind the proxy (health gate).

services.description: Service roll call for init-aware stop/start/status.

imagePrefix.description: VM-local image ref the deploy pipeline tags (sha/latest).

port.description: The container's published/listening port (health gate + proxy target).

shadowProbePort.description: Rolling deploy's shadow container probe port.

deployedShaFile.description: Deployed-sha stamp file on the VM (rollback resolution + status).

envClearKeys.description: Env keys cleared from the service unit env.

migrateScript.description: Repo-relative path of the app's db migrate script (migrate runs it on the VM).
